title: Canonical scalar pullback mate and its composition and tower equations
statement: For arbitrary commutative condensed rings and coefficient maps there exists ScalarSixPullbackData. Its theta has forward map the specified scalarSixPullHom, and it satisfies the geometric composition and canonical scalar-tower equations, with no flatness condition. Uses [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text: Identify each component of scalarSixPullHom with the free-parameter scalar pullback comparison by the unit formula for inverse mates. The existing non-flat invertibility theorem makes these components, and hence the natural transformation, invertible.

The ordinary restriction square composes in geometric morphisms. Exact derived square composition transports this equality, and the generic unit-mate pasting equation gives the theta composition equation.

For coefficient towers, take geometric mates of the ordinary restriction squares. Their direct-image mates and the coefficient restriction compositor are identity on underlying module morphisms. Derive the equality of squares and take scalar mates; the conjugate of restriction transitivity is exactly scalarSixTower.
